NUM global run

Julia/GPU port of NUMmodel (upstream Develop), MITgcm transport matrices

Run: develop_closed_100yr — 2.8° MITgcm, closed POM bottom, Euler step 0.1 d. 52,749 ocean boxes, 100 model years. Wall clock on the GPU: 51 s setup, then 8.9 s per model year (median; the first year includes compilation).
